scoring.equivalent_rule: An 'equivalents' tool fully replaces the expected tool and scores 1.0.
scoring.partial_rule: A 'partials' tool only partly substitutes (weaker/narrower) and scores 0.5.
scoring.multi_tool_rule: 'equivalents'/'partials' are PER-EXPECTED-TOOL maps. A multi-tool task scores the mean over its expected tools, each scored 1.0 if the expected tool or one of its equivalents is selected, else 0.5 if one of its partials is selected, else 0.
